items.name: VICTORIA CHRISTMAS DAY PUBLIC HOLIDAY 2025
items.notes: Strong date match: Christmas Day falls on Thursday 25 Dec 2025; state-wide public holiday status suppresses normal weekday CBD commuter/business demand across the long 05:00-19:00 window.

items.name: MELBOURNE CHRISTMAS DAY 2025 PUBLIC TRANSPORT PATTERN
items.notes: Mixed but supportive: Christmas Day public transport is free but runs to a Sunday timetable, so normal weekday CBD commuting remains suppressed; supports below-baseline with medium strength.

items.name: QUEEN VICTORIA MARKET CHRISTMAS DAY 2025 CLOSURE
items.notes: Local closure match: QVM is listed closed on Christmas Day, supporting reduced activity around the QVM sensor area; explanatory value is local rather than network-wide.

items.name: VICTORIA CHRISTMAS DAY RESTRICTED TRADING 2025
items.notes: Strong closure match: Christmas Day is a restricted trading day in Victoria, with only exempt shops permitted to open; this strongly supports reduced CBD retail and business-related footfall.

items.name: VICTORIA SUMMER SCHOOL HOLIDAY ON CHRISTMAS DAY 2025
items.notes: Supporting calendar match: 25 Dec falls after the 2025 Term 4 finish date, reducing school-related movement; low explanatory value because Christmas public holiday and trading closures are the main drivers.
